regime_context: China A-shares show a highly concentrated 'one narrative' tape — Banks lead with trend durability (0.74) and broad participation (breadth 0.833) but are crowded (z 1.72); rotation breadth is narrow (2/22 eligible), and the backtest verdict confirms the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape). theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed prevailing narrative: eligible, highest rank, trend-tagged, and highest durability_bar (0.74) with broad participation (breadth 0.833). Crowding (z 1.72, crowded=true) and one_narrative=true argue for sizing DOWN but against fading. The trend-gate backtest did not hold on this market, so no edge is claimed — this is a continuation lean conditioned on the trend staying healthy.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Scorable healthcare theme is eligible and crowded (z 1.38) but mixed-trend and mid-pack rank (5th) with moderate durability (0.57). In a one-narrative tape favoring a single confirmed leader, the crowded also-ran has no detector-supported reason for a standalone overweight, and the crowding flag is a size-down caution only — avoidance expresses humilitility rather than a fade call.
theses.dissent: Developmental pharma/CXO has real idiosyncratic catalysts (drug approvals, policy on procurement) that a momentum/trend detector cannot capture, and its trend is not broken — simply mid-cycle.
